ayli_siparisler AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        s.musteri_id,
        substr(s.tarih, 1, 7) as siparis_ay
    FROM siparisler s
),
ay_siralama AS (
    SELECT
        musteri_id,
        siparis_ay,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY musteri_id ORDER BY siparis_ay) as ay_sira
    FROM ayli_siparisler
),
ay_karakter AS (
    SELECT
        s.musteri_id,
        s.siparis_ay,
        s.ay_sira,
        LAG(s.siparis_ay) OVER (PARTITION BY musteri_id ORDER BY s.ay_sira) as oncesi_ay,
        LAG(s.ay_sira) OVER (PARTITION BY musteri_id ORDER BY s.ay_sira) as oncesi_sira,
        julianday(s.siparis_ay) - julianday(COALESCE(LAG(s.siparis_ay) OVER (PARTITION BY musteri_id ORDER BY s.ay_sira), '1900-01-01')) as gun_farki
    FROM ay_siralama s
),
ay_seri AS (
    SELECT
        musteri_id,
        siparis_ay,
        ay_sira,
        oncesi_ay,
        oncesi_sira,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN oncesi_ay IS NOT NULL 
                 AND (julianday(siparis_ay) - julianday(oncesi_ay)) BETWEEN 29 AND 32 
            THEN 0
            ELSE 1 
        END) OVER (PARTITION BY musteri_id ORDER BY ay_sira) as seri_sira
    FROM ay_karakter
),
seri_ozellikler AS (
    SELECT
        musteri_id,
        seri_sira,
        COUNT(*) as ay_sayisi,
        MIN(siparis_ay) as seri_baslangic
    FROM ay_seri
    GROUP BY musteri_id, seri_sira
),
en_uzun AS (
    SELECT
        musteri_id,
        ay_sayisi as seri_uzunluk,
        seri_baslangic,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY musteri_id ORDER BY ay_sayisi DESC, seri_baslangic ASC) as rnk
    FROM seri_ozellikler
)

    e.seri_uzunluk,
    e.seri_baslangic

JOIN musteriler m ON e.musteri_id = m.id
WHERE e.rnk = 1
  AND e.seri_uzunluk >= 3
ORDER BY e.seri_uzunluk DESC, m.ad ASC
